catalogue: Australian residential roof coverings and weathering components

ncc_references.relationship: Roof-cladding pathway context. The applicable metal, plastic, tile, slate or shingle path and all project limitations must be checked.

objects.name: roof covering system
objects.definition: The weather-exposed roof assembly above its structural framing, including the selected sheets, tiles, slates or shingles and the compatible laps, fixings, underlays, flashings and cappings needed to shed water.
functions: Resist assigned wind and weather actions
Coordinate coverings, fixings, penetrations, flashings and drainage edges

cad.pattern: Continuous weathering assembly over all scheduled roof planes
cad.placement: Above roof framing and battens and below open sky
cad.start: Eaves, parapet or lower roof boundary
cad.end: Ridge, wall or upper roof boundary
cad.opening: Interrupted only by detailed penetrations with complete flashing
cad.load: Weathering assembly with system-specific structural action

notes: A roof covering is not complete merely because sheets or tiles fill the roof-plane outline.

objects.name: metal sheet roof assembly
objects.definition: A roof covering assembled from profiled metal sheets fixed to battens or other immediate supports, with compatible sheet joints, fixings, cappings and flashings.
functions: Carry assigned wind actions to roof supports
Drain water along profiled sheets to the roof edge

cad.pattern: Parallel profiled sheets laid from eaves toward ridge with designed side laps
cad.placement: Over roof battens or other immediate supports
cad.opening: Sheets are cut only around fully supported and flashed penetrations
cad.load: Self-supporting cladding between immediate supports within the selected system

objects.name: pierced-fixed metal sheet roof
objects.definition: A metal sheet roof in which primary fasteners pass through the roof sheets into their supports at the scheduled profile locations.
functions: Transfer wind actions through visible fasteners
Maintain weathering through compatible washers and correct lap geometry

cad.pattern: Profiled sheets with fasteners passing through at repeated support lines
cad.placement: On the roof support grid
cad.opening: Penetrations require separate flashing and support details

objects.name: concealed-fixed metal sheet roof
objects.definition: A metal sheet roof in which hidden clips are fixed to the supports and the profiled sheets engage those clips without exposed primary fasteners through the weathering field.
functions: Secure roof sheets through hidden clips
Allow system-specific sheet engagement and movement
Keep primary fixing penetrations below the weathering sheet

cad.pattern: Rows of concealed clips under interlocking profiled sheets
cad.placement: On aligned roof supports
cad.end: Final partial or full sheet under capping
cad.opening: Penetrations interrupt the clip and sheet layout and require designed details

notes: A manufacturer system definition is needed; concealed-fixed profiles are not geometrically interchangeable.

objects.name: plastic sheet roof assembly
objects.definition: A roof covering made from profiled or formed plastic sheets installed with compatible supports, laps, fasteners, washers and flashings as a complete product system.
functions: Admit light where translucent products are selected
Transfer assigned actions to its supporting structure
materials: polycarbonate, PVC, glass-fibre reinforced plastic or other scheduled plastic

cad.pattern: Profiled plastic sheets overlapped and fixed over supports
cad.placement: On roof planes nominated for plastic sheet cladding

notes: Part 7.2 does not replace the AS 1562.3 pathway for plastic roofing.

objects.name: tiled roof assembly
objects.definition: A roof covering of overlapping concrete, terracotta or other compliant roof tiles laid in courses over battens, with mechanical fixings, capping tiles, flashings and sarking where required.
functions: Shed water through overlapping tile courses
Resist wind uplift through the selected fixing pattern
Weather ridges, hips, barges, valleys and penetrations with compatible accessories
not_synonyms: roof tiles without battens and details

cad.pattern: Overlapping tile courses from eaves to ridge on repeated battens
cad.placement: Over timber or steel roof battens
cad.opening: Tiles are cut around fully flashed penetrations and valleys
cad.load: Discrete overlapping roof covering supported by battens

objects.name: non-interlocking roof slate or shingle assembly
objects.definition: A roof covering of individually fixed, non-interlocking terracotta, fibre-cement or timber slates or shingles laid in overlapping courses as a complete weathering system.
functions: Transfer wind and self-weight actions through individual fixings

cad.pattern: Individually fixed overlapping units in courses
cad.placement: Over the support and underlay system named by the project detail
cad.opening: Units are cut and flashed around penetrations

notes: This family follows the Volume Two AS 4597 pathway and is not generated from the limited Part 7.3 roof-tile rules.

objects.name: profiled metal roof sheet
objects.definition: A length of thin metal roof cladding formed with repeated ribs, crests, pans or corrugations so it can span between supports and drain water down the roof plane.
functions: Form the main exposed roof skin

cad.pattern: Parallel full-length or end-lapped sheets at nominal cover width
cad.placement: From eaves toward ridge over support lines

notes: Brand and coating names remain product attributes rather than canonical generic object names.

objects.name: corrugated metal roof sheet
objects.definition: A profiled metal roof sheet with a repeating rounded wave-like corrugation across its width.
functions: Create nesting side laps between adjoining sheets

cad.pattern: Rounded corrugations repeated across each sheet and nested at side laps
cad.placement: On roof planes scheduled for corrugated sheeting

objects.name: trapezoidal metal roof sheet
objects.definition: A profiled metal roof sheet with repeated angular ribs and broad pans forming trapezoidal cross-sectional features.

cad.pattern: Angular ribs and pans repeated across each sheet
cad.placement: On roof planes scheduled for trapezoidal sheeting

objects.name: concealed-fixed metal roof sheet
objects.definition: A proprietary profiled metal roof sheet shaped to engage hidden fixing clips along its ribs or seams.

cad.pattern: Sheets sequentially engaged over aligned hidden clips
cad.placement: Within a selected concealed-fixed roof system

notes: Exact rib and seam geometry must come from the selected product system.

objects.name: profiled plastic roof sheet
objects.definition: A formed plastic sheet used as roof cladding, usually with a profiled shape that overlaps adjacent sheets and spans between scheduled supports.
functions: Span between supports within the product system

cad.pattern: Profiled sheets overlapped at sides and ends as detailed
cad.placement: Within a plastic sheet roof assembly
cad.opening: Oversized or shaped fixing holes and penetrations follow the selected system

objects.name: roof tile
objects.definition: A rigid small roof-covering unit shaped to overlap or interlock with adjacent units and hang or bear on a roof batten while shedding water down the roof.
functions: Interlock or overlap with adjoining tiles

cad.pattern: Repeated in staggered or aligned horizontal courses at product cover dimensions
cad.placement: On roof battens between eaves and ridge
cad.opening: Cut tiles frame valleys, hips, penetrations and boundaries

objects.name: concrete roof tile
objects.definition: A moulded concrete roof tile supplied in a compatible field and accessory system for overlapping or interlocking tiled roofs.
functions: Interlock or overlap in tile courses

cad.pattern: Repeated as field and cut tiles in courses
cad.placement: Within a compatible tiled roof system
cad.opening: Cut only to detailed roof boundaries

objects.name: terracotta roof tile
objects.definition: A fired-clay roof tile supplied in a compatible field and accessory system for overlapping or interlocking tiled roofs.
functions: Interlock or overlap in tile courses

cad.pattern: Repeated as field and cut tiles in courses
cad.placement: Within a compatible tiled roof system
cad.opening: Cut only to detailed roof boundaries

objects.name: interlocking roof tile
objects.definition: A roof tile with shaped side or side-and-head locks that engage adjoining tiles and control their course spacing and weathering path.
functions: Control water passage through shaped joints

cad.pattern: Repeated units engaged through product-specific locks
cad.placement: Within tiled roof field courses
cad.opening: Cut tiles lose some lock geometry and require boundary detailing

objects.name: non-interlocking roof slate or shingle
objects.definition: A relatively thin individual roof-covering unit without interlocking edges, fixed in overlapping courses so upper units cover the joints and fixings below.
functions: Form an overlapping small-unit roof covering

cad.pattern: Individually fixed overlapping courses
cad.placement: Within a non-interlocking slate or shingle roof
cad.opening: Cut units finish around roof boundaries

objects.name: terracotta roof slate or shingle
objects.definition: A non-interlocking fired-clay roof slate or shingle laid in overlapping courses and fixed individually.

cad.pattern: Repeated in overlapping individually fixed courses
cad.placement: Within the selected slate or shingle assembly
cad.load: Material subtype of slate or shingle

objects.name: fibre-cement roof slate or shingle
objects.definition: A non-interlocking fibre-cement roof unit fixed individually in overlapping courses.

cad.pattern: Repeated in overlapping individually fixed courses
cad.placement: Within the selected slate or shingle assembly
cad.load: Material subtype of slate or shingle

objects.name: timber roof shingle
objects.definition: A thin timber roof-covering unit fixed individually in overlapping courses so each upper course covers the joints and fixings below.
materials: durable or treated timber suitable for the selected system

cad.pattern: Repeated in overlapping individually fixed courses
cad.placement: Within the selected timber shingle assembly
cad.load: Material subtype of slate or shingle

objects.name: ridge capping tile
objects.definition: A shaped tile laid along a roof ridge to cover the joint between the top courses on opposing roof planes.
functions: Receive bedding, pointing and mechanical fixing or another designed ridge system

cad.pattern: Repeated end-lapped units along the ridge line
cad.placement: Over the meeting of opposing tiled roof planes
cad.opening: Interrupted and detailed at ridge penetrations or vents

objects.name: hip capping tile
objects.definition: A shaped tile laid down a roof hip to cover the cut edges and joint between the two adjoining tiled roof planes.
functions: Receive bedding, pointing and mechanical fixing or another designed hip system

cad.pattern: Repeated end-lapped units up the hip line
cad.placement: Over the meeting of two tiled roof planes at a hip
cad.opening: Cut and detailed at intersecting features

objects.name: barge capping tile
objects.definition: A purpose-made tile or tile fitting used along the sloping verge of a tiled roof to weather and finish the edge beside the barge or gable.
functions: Provide an individually fixed edge accessory

cad.pattern: Repeated or continuous accessory units along a gable verge
cad.placement: At the sloping edge of a tiled roof

objects.name: hip starter tile
objects.definition: A purpose-made first capping unit at the lower end of a tiled roof hip that closes and finishes the exposed end of the hip-tile run.
functions: Provide a fixed and pointed weathering termination

cad.pattern: One at the eaves end of each hip-capping run
cad.placement: At the lower end of a tiled roof hip

objects.name: metal roofing screw
objects.definition: A corrosion-compatible screw used to fasten metal or plastic roof cladding, clips or accessories to the supporting member or adjoining sheet.
functions: Compress a sealing washer where the screw penetrates the weathering sheet
materials: stainless steel or other compatible metal
integral or separate sealing washer where required

cad.pattern: Repeated at scheduled ribs and support intersections or accessory fixing points
cad.placement: Through cladding or clip into a roof support
cad.opening: Occupies a formed or drilled fixing hole

notes: Product, metal compatibility, washer and substrate must be resolved before drawing a specific screw.

objects.name: roofing screw sealing washer
objects.definition: A resilient washer beneath a roof-fixing head that seals around the fastener penetration while distributing clamping pressure to the sheet.
functions: Isolate compatible metal faces where the selected assembly requires it
materials: synthetic rubber with metal backing where specified

cad.pattern: One beneath each penetrating screw head where the system requires it
cad.placement: Between fastener head and roof sheet

objects.name: metal roof concealed fixing clip
objects.definition: A hidden formed-metal clip fixed to a roof support and shaped to engage the ribs or seams of a compatible concealed-fixed roof sheet.
functions: Attach the sheet without penetrating its weathering field
Permit or control longitudinal movement as the selected system requires
materials: coated steel or other compatible metal

cad.pattern: Repeated at sheet ribs on each support line
cad.placement: Between roof support and concealed-fixed sheet

objects.name: metal roof sheet side-lap fastener
objects.definition: A small screw or rivet joining the overlapping edges of adjacent roof sheets between or at their supports where the selected system requires lap restraint.
functions: Hold a sheet side lap closed
Transfer local force between adjoining sheet edges

cad.pattern: Repeated along selected sheet side laps
cad.placement: Through the overlapping rib or edge of adjoining sheets
cad.end: Thread or rivet tail through lap

objects.name: roof sheet side-lap joint
objects.definition: The longitudinal overlap and engagement between the side edges of two adjoining roof sheets, including any anti-capillary feature and lap fasteners.
functions: Accommodate profile nesting or seam engagement
materials: compatible fasteners or sealants where specified

cad.pattern: Continuous joint along adjoining sheet edges
cad.placement: Parallel to the roof fall
cad.opening: Maintains drainage path without open gaps

objects.name: roof sheet end-lap joint
objects.definition: The transverse overlap where an upper roof sheet extends over the top end of a lower sheet because one full-length sheet cannot cover the complete roof run.
functions: Continue sheet covering along the roof fall
Shed water from upper sheet to lower sheet
Join sheet ends with the specified support, lap and sealing detail

cad.pattern: One transverse joint at each sheet-length break
cad.placement: Across the roof plane with upper sheet over lower sheet

objects.name: metal roof sheet rib end stop
objects.definition: A purpose-made closure fitted into or beside the open end of a concealed-fixed roof-sheet rib to block the rib cavity at an eaves or other termination.
functions: Reduce entry of wind-driven rain, debris or pests
Protect concealed clips near the termination
materials: compatible coated metal or proprietary polymer

cad.pattern: One at each open rib end where specified
cad.placement: At the eaves or terminating end of a concealed-fixed rib

objects.name: profiled roof infill strip
objects.definition: A shaped strip matching a roof-sheet profile and fitted beneath or above the sheet to close repeated gaps at an eaves, ridge, wall or other termination.
functions: Reduce entry of wind-driven rain, dust, insects or birds
Support a detailed air or fire seal where a suitable product is selected
attributes: fire or bushfire classification where relevant

cad.pattern: Continuous or segmented strip across repeated sheet profile gaps
cad.placement: At a roof-sheet termination under a flashing, capping or edge

objects.name: roof tile clip
objects.definition: A purpose-made metal fastener shaped to grip a roof tile and attach it to a batten or adjacent tile at a defined part of the tile profile.
functions: Resist tile displacement and wind uplift
Suit a specific tile location and profile

cad.pattern: Repeated at the selected fixed tiles and locations
cad.placement: Between tile and batten or adjacent tile
cad.opening: Fits the product profile without creating an arbitrary hole

objects.name: roof tile head-lap clip
objects.definition: A tile clip shaped to restrain the head-lap region where an upper roof tile overlaps the head of the tile below.
functions: Restrain a tile at its head lap

cad.pattern: At selected head-lap locations
cad.placement: Within the overlap between upper and lower tiles

objects.name: roof tile side-lap clip
objects.definition: A tile clip shaped to restrain the side-lock or side-overlap region between adjoining roof tiles.

cad.pattern: At selected side-lap locations
cad.placement: Within the side overlap or lock between tiles

objects.name: short-course roof tile clip
objects.definition: A purpose-made clip used to restrain shortened or specially arranged roof-tile courses where ordinary full-tile fixing geometry is unavailable.
functions: Provide product-specific restraint at truncated tile zones

cad.pattern: At scheduled short-course tile locations
cad.placement: Where a shortened course meets roof geometry or accessories

objects.name: roof tile valley clip
objects.definition: A purpose-made clip used to restrain cut roof tiles beside a valley where normal tile locks or fixing points may be removed.
functions: Keep tile edges clear of the drainage channel

cad.pattern: At selected cut tiles along both valley sides
cad.placement: Beside a roof valley drainage channel

objects.name: hip starter tile clip
objects.definition: A purpose-made clip used to mechanically restrain the hip starter tile at the exposed lower end of a tiled roof hip.
functions: Resist movement at the exposed hip end
Supplement the bedding and pointing system

cad.pattern: One at each hip starter where specified
cad.placement: Between the hip starter and its batten or support

objects.name: ridge tile clip
objects.definition: A metal clip anchored near the top tile battens and shaped to mechanically restrain a ridge capping tile.

cad.pattern: At each ridge tile or scheduled spacing
cad.placement: From the top batten zone to the ridge tile

objects.name: roof tile clout nail
objects.definition: A corrosion-protected large-head nail used through a tile fixing hole to mechanically attach a roof tile or capping accessory to a timber batten or other compatible support.
functions: Provide a broad bearing head at the tile hole
materials: galvanized or non-ferrous metal as selected

cad.pattern: At tiles selected by the fixing schedule
cad.placement: Through a tile fixing hole into a timber batten
cad.opening: Uses the tile's provided fixing hole

objects.name: roof tile fixing screw
objects.definition: A purpose-selected screw used through a roof tile or capping fixing point to attach it mechanically to a compatible batten or support.
functions: Mechanically fix a tile or capping unit
Provide controlled threaded engagement with the support

cad.pattern: At tiles and cappings selected by the fixing schedule
cad.placement: Through the provided fixing point into the batten or special support
cad.opening: Uses or forms the detailed fixing point

objects.name: roof tile ridge and hip mortar bedding
objects.definition: A shaped bed of mortar placed beneath ridge, hip or starter capping tiles to support their line and fill the larger irregular space above the field tiles.
functions: Fill the bulk gap beneath capping
Provide a base for compatible pointing

cad.pattern: Continuous shaped bed beneath a capping run with required drainage breaks
cad.placement: Between field tiles and ridge, hip or starter tiles
cad.opening: Preserves documented weep or ventilation paths
cad.load: Bedding and alignment layer, not sole mechanical fixing

objects.name: flexible roof tile pointing
objects.definition: A flexible compound applied over the exposed edge of ridge or hip bedding to adhere to the tiles, finish the joint and resist weather entry while accommodating limited movement.

cad.pattern: Continuous tooled strip along both exposed sides of a bedded capping run
cad.placement: Between capping tiles and field tiles over mortar bedding
cad.load: Weather seal and adhesive component, not a substitute for required mechanical fixing

objects.name: roof sarking or pliable roof underlay
objects.definition: A pliable sheet or roll installed beneath roof tiles or roof sheeting to provide a secondary drainage, weather-control or vapour-control layer according to its documented classification.
functions: Drain incidental water toward the eaves
Reduce entry of wind-driven rain and dust
Provide documented vapour or reflective functions where the selected product and airspaces support them
materials: vapour-permeable or vapour-resistant underlay as selected

cad.pattern: Continuous lapped sheet field across roof supports or substrate
cad.placement: Below roof covering and normally above rafters or truss top chords
cad.end: Ridge, upper lap or wall termination
cad.opening: Cut and sealed around penetrations with continuity maintained
cad.load: Secondary weather and vapour-control layer, not primary roof cladding

notes: Sarking, underlay, reflective insulation and vapour-control layer can share a product but are not universal synonyms in every assembly.

objects.name: roof sarking joint tape
objects.definition: A compatible adhesive tape used to join, seal or repair roof-sarking sheets where the selected membrane system requires taped continuity.
functions: Maintain the documented air, water or vapour-control continuity
materials: pressure-sensitive adhesive tape compatible with the membrane

cad.pattern: Continuous strip over selected membrane laps, cuts and repairs
cad.placement: On the compatible face of roof sarking
cad.opening: Forms sealed rings or patches around detailed penetrations

objects.name: tiled-roof anti-ponding board
objects.definition: A water-resistant board or device fixed at the eaves beneath tiled-roof sarking to support its lower edge and direct incidental water over the fascia or into the drainage path without forming a low pocket.
functions: Prevent water ponding behind the fascia
materials: water-resistant board or proprietary formed device

cad.pattern: Continuous or jointed strip along the eaves beneath sarking
cad.placement: From fascia top back toward the rafter below the first tile batten
cad.load: Secondary drainage support, not a roof batten

objects.name: roof flashing
objects.definition: A shaped weather-resistant sheet or moulded fitting installed at a roof junction, edge or penetration to collect and redirect water onto the roof drainage path.
functions: Divert water away from openings and vulnerable interfaces
Lap with adjacent coverings in the direction of flow

cad.pattern: Continuous or locally tray-shaped run along a vulnerable interface
cad.placement: At roof edges, walls, changes of plane and penetrations
cad.opening: Wraps or trays around the detailed opening

notes: Material compatibility and drinking-water catchment limits are assembly attributes, not reasons to merge all flashing products.

objects.name: metal roof ridge capping
objects.definition: A purpose-folded metal capping covering the junction at the top of two sheet-roof planes and lapping over the upper ends of their profiles.
functions: Cover sheet turn-ups and profile ends

cad.pattern: Continuous folded lengths lapped along the ridge
cad.placement: Over sheet ends at the meeting of roof planes
cad.opening: Detailed around ridge penetrations or vents

objects.name: metal roof hip capping
objects.definition: A purpose-folded metal capping running down an external roof hip and covering the cut or terminated edges of adjoining sheet-roof planes.
functions: Direct water away from the hip junction

cad.pattern: Continuous folded lengths lapped down the hip
cad.placement: Over the external junction of two sheet-roof planes

objects.name: metal roof barge capping
objects.definition: A folded metal capping covering the sloping gable edge of sheet roofing and turning down over or beside the barge or wall edge.
functions: Direct water away from the barge and wall

cad.pattern: Continuous folded lengths along the sloping gable edge
cad.placement: Over the final sheet rib or cut edge and down the barge face

objects.name: roof apron flashing
objects.definition: A flashing with an upper upstand or attachment at a wall or penetration and a lower apron that extends down over the roof covering to discharge water onto it.
functions: Weather the lower side of a wall or penetration
Bridge from vertical surface to roof covering
Discharge collected water over the covering

cad.pattern: Continuous strip across the downslope side of an abutment
cad.placement: From wall or penetration down over roof covering
cad.opening: Forms part of a complete penetration or wall tray

objects.name: roof step flashing
objects.definition: A series of short overlapping flashing pieces stepped up a sloping roof-to-wall junction so each piece turns into or behind the wall and laps onto the roof covering below.
functions: Follow masonry courses or cladding steps
Pass water from each upper piece onto the next lower piece
materials: compatible folded or mouldable flashing material

cad.pattern: Overlapping stepped pieces up a roof-to-wall line
cad.placement: At a sloping roof abutting masonry or stepped cladding

objects.name: roof counterflashing or overflashing
objects.definition: A flashing fixed into or behind an abutting wall and lapped down over the upstand of an apron, step or base flashing so water cannot enter behind the lower flashing.
functions: Cover the top edge of a lower flashing
Shed wall water over the roof flashing
Allow separate wall and roof flashing layers where detailed
materials: compatible folded or mouldable flashing material

cad.pattern: Continuous or stepped run above the lower flashing upstand
cad.placement: In or behind the abutting wall surface

objects.name: roof parapet capping
objects.definition: A folded or formed weathering cap covering the top of a parapet and turning down over its exposed faces or connecting flashings.
functions: Direct water away from wall faces
Lap with roof and wall flashings at terminations

cad.pattern: Continuous capped run along parapet top
cad.placement: Over the full parapet width

objects.name: roof change-of-pitch flashing
objects.definition: A transverse flashing joining two roof-covering planes of different pitches and passing water from the upper plane onto the lower plane without exposing the change line.
functions: Weather a change in roof pitch
Bridge upper and lower covering profiles
Maintain drainage across the angle change

cad.pattern: Continuous transverse run along the pitch-change line
cad.placement: Between upper and lower roof-covering planes
cad.opening: Detailed around intersecting penetrations or valleys

objects.name: roof penetration collar flashing
objects.definition: A purpose-made flashing collar surrounding a pipe or similar roof penetration, with an upstand sealed to the penetration and an apron or base draining onto the roof covering.
functions: Drain the roof area above and beside the penetration
not_synonyms: apron flashing for a large penetration

cad.pattern: One collar assembly at each compatible small penetration
cad.placement: Around the penetration on the roof weathering plane

objects.name: roof penetration soaker tray
objects.definition: A tray-shaped flashing installed upslope of or around a larger roof penetration to collect roof runoff and divert it around or over the obstruction before discharging back onto the roof.
functions: Divert water around a large penetration
Return collected water to the roof drainage path

cad.pattern: One shaped tray for each detailed large penetration
cad.placement: Upslope and beside the penetration beneath or over cut sheet edges as detailed

notes: Head gutter, soaker gutter and soaker tray usage varies with detail; geometry and flow role must disambiguate the command.

objects.name: roof chimney flashing assembly
objects.definition: The coordinated set of apron, side or step, back-tray and counterflashings that weather all sides of a chimney where it passes through a roof covering.
functions: Divert upslope water around the chimney
Lap roof and wall flashing layers in drainage order

cad.pattern: One multi-part flashing assembly around each chimney
cad.placement: At the chimney-to-roof junction

notes: The assembly may use step or continuous side flashings depending on wall and roof covering.

objects.name: roof covering penetration opening
objects.definition: A deliberately formed opening through the roof covering and any associated underlay for a pipe, flue, duct, rooflight or other installed object, bounded by a complete support and flashing detail.
functions: Provide passage through the roof covering
Define the cut edge and clearance zone
Host the required penetration flashing assembly
materials: void through roof covering and underlay

cad.pattern: Only at individually scheduled roof penetrations
cad.placement: Through covering, underlay and supporting build-up
cad.opening: The object is the opening and cut-edge boundary
cad.load: Non-solid feature requiring support and weathering

notes: An intersecting service path must create a clash, not an automatic roof cut.
